title: A50 Source Register row
description: Schema for one row of analysis/canonical/core_controls/A50_source_register.csv. Documented in skills/bsa-orchestrator/references/shared-control-surface-contracts.md (A50 Minimal Columns). Reliability tiers per skills/bsa-evidence-intake/references/reliability_tier_spec.md.

SourceID.description: Stable identifier. Two recognized shapes: S-NNN (numeric, simple register) or S-XXX-NNN (category prefix like INJ for injection-related sources). Engagements with >999 sources of one category extend to NNNN.

SourceType.description: Source classification. Open vocabulary (lowercase_with_underscore). Common values: document, policy_document, interview_transcript, process_note, config_file, code, screenshot, ticket, dashboard.

Origin.description: Provenance: file path, URL, or stakeholder attribution. May be empty for in-memory/transient sources but typically required.

AccessStatus.description: Whether the source content is currently accessible. Anything other than 'readable' triggers an A51 missing_source route per workflow-contract.

ReliabilityTier.description: Epistemic-proximity tier per reliability_tier_spec.md: T1 empirical / T2 authored-primary / T3 authored-secondary / T4 attestation / T5 reported. ClaimStrength derives from this (T1=1.00, T2=0.85, T3=0.65, T4=0.45, T5=0.20).

Priority.description: Triage priority for evidence-intake processing order.

Language.description: BCP-47-ish language tag (en, en-US, ru, es-MX, ...). Lowercase primary, optional uppercase region.

DateOrVersion.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), semver, commit hash, or 'unknown'. Free-form.

EffectiveDate.description: Optional ISO-8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) on which the source content became authoritative — i.e. the publication / signing / commit date the operator considers definitive for freshness assessment. Distinct from DateOrVersion (which is free-form provenance — version tag, commit hash, etc.). Accepted values: a real date (`YYYY-MM-DD`), the literal string `unknown` (operator declares 'cannot assess'), OR the empty string (gradual row-by-row backfill — same semantics as the field being absent on a pre-v1.2.16 row). When present and parseable, freshness_audit.py compares (now - EffectiveDate) against the freshness_threshold_days tunable and routes stale sources via A51. Empty / `unknown` / absent → audit emits `n/a` for that row, never blocks.

ContentHash.description: v1.4.4: SHA-256 hex digest of the original (pre-conversion) source file's bytes. 64 lowercase hex characters when populated; empty string when unknown (e.g., `bsa materials --recreate-manifest` ran without raw/ retention OR the source file was unreadable at staging time). Set at staging time by `bsa materials --commit`. Used by `bsa materials --restage-changed` to detect when a source's bytes changed between staging runs (skip-if-unchanged optimization). Downstream evidence-binding can also audit (does the file at Origin still match this hash, or was it modified after stage 1 froze the manifest?).

OriginalBytes.description: v1.4.4: byte length of the original source file at staging time. Decimal integer string when populated; empty string when unknown. Pair with ContentHash for cheap mtime/size pre-check before the full sha256 compare in --restage-changed.

OriginalMtimeUtc.description: v1.4.4: ISO-8601 UTC mtime (second precision) of the original source file at staging time. Format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`. Empty when unknown. Combined with OriginalBytes gives a cheap pre-check before the full hash compare.

x-bsa-csv-columns-order._comment: Canonical column order for diff stability. `order` is the closed set of required CSV columns. `optional_order` lists columns that MAY appear (introduced v1.2.16 to keep new fields backward-compatible at the CSV-shape layer; v1.4.4 adds ContentHash + OriginalBytes + OriginalMtimeUtc). When present, optional columns SHOULD appear in the listed order, between DateOrVersion and Notes, but consumers tolerate any ordering. The CSV column-set check accepts a row file whose actual column set is `order` (alone) OR `order + any subset of optional_order`. Pre-v1.2.16, post-v1.2.16 (with EffectiveDate), and post-v1.4.4 (with hash columns) A50 CSVs are all valid.

x-bsa-uniqueness-rules._comment: EXECUTABLE at the F5 hook layer as of v1.2.12 via governance/schemas/write_validator.py::_apply_uniqueness_rules. Schema-agnostic generic extension (see v1.2.10 CHANGELOG). Every A50 row declares a distinct source; duplicate SourceIDs would break every downstream cross-reference (A58 excerpts, A59 claims, etc.) by making the FK resolution ambiguous. Pre-v1.2.12 duplicate SourceIDs were caught only at fixture-review time; v1.2.12 makes it mechanical at hook time.
x-bsa-uniqueness-rules.rationale: Without this rule, duplicate SourceID values could land at promote-gate + silently break every downstream cross-reference. SourceID is the row-identifier.

x-bsa-strict-date-rules._comment: v1.2.16 R2 fix: per-row check that any non-empty, non-'unknown' value in the listed columns is a REAL calendar date. The schema's `pattern` enforces shape (YYYY-MM-DD), but `2025-02-30` and `2025-13-99` pass the regex while not being valid dates — they would silently sail through F5 validation and then be reported as `n/a` by freshness_audit.py, hiding broken backfill from the operator. Handler `_apply_strict_date_rules` in `governance/schemas/write_validator.py` parses each listed cell via datetime.strptime('%Y-%m-%d') and emits a violation on ValueError. Empty string and 'unknown' are explicitly skipped (they are gradual-backfill / cannot-assess sentinels per a50.schema.json::EffectiveDate description).

x-bsa-tier-claim-strength._comment: ReliabilityTier → ClaimStrength mapping per reliability_tier_spec.md. Used by A59 schema validation to verify upstream tier consistency.
